fine.label: Fine resolution
fine.preprocessing: Reverse descending source frequency axis; display 10*log10(power) minus median of each selected row; clip the global 1st–99.7th percentile range and quantize to 8-bit. No injected signals, smoothing, or spectral interpolation.
fine.limits: All 16 native fine integrations are shown. The reference follows the strongest native channel within ±300 Hz of the tutorial’s expected carrier frequency; this is a guided carrier reference, not a blind identification.
fine.referenceMethod: Strongest power within ±300 Hz of expected frequency per displayed row
fine.rawCutoutHashEncoding: SHA-256 of row-major little-endian float32 linear-power sample bytes, not the NPZ container file.

mid.label: Mid resolution
mid.preprocessing: Reverse descending source frequency axis; display 10*log10(power) minus median of each selected row; clip the global 1st–99.7th percentile range and quantize to 8-bit. No injected signals, smoothing, or spectral interpolation.
mid.limits: One in every four native mid-resolution integrations is displayed to keep this browser cutout small. Spectral columns remain native. Reference is the native channel nearest the tutorial’s expected carrier frequency; drift within that channel is unresolved.
mid.referenceMethod: Native frequency channel nearest expected carrier frequency
mid.rawCutoutHashEncoding: SHA-256 of row-major little-endian float32 linear-power sample bytes, not the NPZ container file.
